methodology.title: M-04F evidentiary stratigraphy and moving waterline
methodology.purpose: Classify evidentiary durability without converting record depth into truth beyond the bounded proposition.

states.meaning: A decisive transition remains an exact acquisition problem; absence of proof is not a non-link.
A plausible bounded proposition has accumulated but has not compacted through independent, consequential, or counterfactual evidence.
A source-bounded fact supports review, but corroboration, consequence, counterpower, or counterfactual evidence remains thin.
Multiple independent durability signals converge on the same bounded proposition.

The bounded proposition is anchored by compulsory adjudication, direct affected-person evidence, operated counterfactuals, or independently reconstructable consequences. Bedrock never promotes the total theory.
A bounded non-link or falsifier constrains the map and prevents silent bridge-building.

classification_law.supported_for_human_review: Signal-based classification into settled_sediment, compacted_stratum, or bedrock.
classification_law.bedrock_rule: A supported record is bedrock only when it has compulsory remedy plus independent custody and burden shift, or direct affected voice plus compulsory remedy plus consequence, or an operated counterfactual plus compulsory remedy and independent custody.
classification_law.compacted_rule: A supported record with at least three durability signals is compacted_stratum; otherwise it is settled_sediment.

states.offshore_fog: Four or more vertical joins remain absent.
states.shoaling: At least three joins are present but direct voice, remedy, or counterfactual remains absent.
states.contested_shore: Direct voice and remedy exist, but threshold, custody, consequence, or counterfactual remains incomplete.
states.bounded_landfall: At least five joins are present including direct voice, consequence, remedy, and counterfactual. This permits only bounded human review.
